title: MayersScott/rkn-block-checker
claim: MayersScott/rkn-block-checker — Diagnose RKN/TSPU internet blocks layer by layer (DNS, TCP, TLS, HTTP)
why_good: Diagnoses Russian RKN/TSPU internet blocks layer by layer (DNS/TCP/TLS/HTTP) — a genuinely useful anti-censorship diagnostic for a real, urgent audience.
value: Hard to monetize (activism/free by nature); value is impact + a possible NGO/enterprise-monitoring tier.
risk: Politically sensitive, grant/donation-shaped, not a commercial business; the audience can't easily pay.

zh.claim: MayersScott/rkn-block-checker —— 逐层诊断 RKN/TSPU 的网络封锁(DNS、TCP、TLS、HTTP)。
zh.why_good: 逐层诊断俄罗斯 RKN/TSPU 的网络封锁——对真实、紧迫的受众是个确实有用的反审查诊断工具。
zh.value: 很难变现(本质是行动主义/免费);价值在影响力,或许做 NGO/企业监测档。
zh.risk: 政治敏感、更像拨款/捐赠形态,不是商业生意;受众也难付费。
